    04

    Ascend NFT mechanics

    NFT reward
    weighting.

    Ascend’s proposed model places the NFT benefit inside the direct HYPE reward pool. An eligible NFT increases the weight applied to its holder’s eligible HYPE stake for that distribution. The pool size varies with protocol revenue and HYPE purchase prices; the NFT does not add funds to it. Exact boosts and eligibility thresholds remain undisclosed.

    Verify in the Ascend NFT docs ↗
    DIRECT HYPE REWARD POOL $375
    Existing pool
    100%
    Proposed Higher reward weighting

    Requires an eligible HYPE staking position.

    Mint plan 500 supply · free mint

    Builders are one planned access group; inclusion does not guarantee a whitelist allocation.

    Undisclosed Exact boost rates

    Tier quantities, thresholds and exact boosts are not published.

    Live chain modules read Elysium’s public RPC and official explorer API. The Ascend module models the published proposal. This independent tool is not an audit, endorsement, investment recommendation or proof of identity, ownership, authorship, builder status or whitelist eligibility.

    CURRENT BOUNDARY · CHECKED 10 OCT 2026

    Elysium’s public testnet RPC and official explorer API are accessible. Ascend’s application remains outside this tool. Every module is read-only and sends no transactions.
